piece.headline: AYODELE TRIPLES UP and the title race tightens
piece.one_to_watch: Isaiah and Dominic are split by 1 point at the Tin Pot line. Whoever has the better week could decide who ends up on the wrong side of it.

winners.name: Raushan
winners.verdict: 4 places up in one week. Raushan moved from the pack to the chasing group while others stood still.

winners.name: Omar
winners.verdict: Omar was well clear of the average. 10 more points were sitting on the bench, so the week could have been bigger.

losers.name: IB
losers.verdict: Went alone with Calvert-Lewin as captain and it never took off. Brave call, bad luck, better week ahead.

losers.name: Bhavik
losers.verdict: Left 11 points on the bench. That is selection, not luck, and the Gold line is only 4 points away.
